name: Joel Little
notes: Minimal-percussion pop producer working from a single Auckland room. The research gives the backbeat as a coin flip — "the minimal mode's backbeat lands on 3 (half-time feel) as often as on 2&4" — and a single `placement` field cannot hold both, so `halfTime` is true at `halftime_3` and the 50/50 is recorded here rather than averaged into a wrong number. The drum block is a subtraction claim: "the identity is subtraction — finger snaps, one deep kick and a hip-hop-derived backbeat, no hat bed, and whole verses running on snaps alone. Lo-fi by choice, with the whole record cut in a week." So the kick density is a flat 1, the snare stack is `snap` alone, `hihat.continuous` is false at `fillDensity` 0.03 — the lowest authored in this section — with the roll vocabulary off, and the `snap` perc lane runs at high density with a forward gain, because whole verses are made of it. His axis overlaps his best-known artist by design, and the difference authored is the one his own entry gives: the pop-punk background. "He came from pop-punk, so cadences remain functional underneath" is why a V-bearing family sits in the set where the artist model has none, and `chordToneBias` is higher. Mode is the same documented Mixolydian — "the record that defined him is notated G major functioning as D Mixolydian — so major-with-flat-7 and three-chord loops with the flat-7 as the colour chord" — which is `maxChords` 3 and the mixolydian weighting. No `bass808` block: "sub-bass and round synth bass on roots, mixed loud so that bass-plus-vocal-stack is a complete arrangement", which is a near-static root line and, on the other side, a counter at high density because "countermelody is a stacked vocal, not an instrument". His documented method is structural: "building song structures out of the artist's lyrics rather than imposing a form", so the arrangement carries short intros, no solo slot and an abrupt reduction to one voice. ⚠ `confidence` is medium against a high-medium rating because every drum probability, the humanize numbers, `bpm.mode` 100 (the research gives 85—130 with no centre, so the mode is that band's midpoint) and `session.keys` beyond G and D are INFERRED — the entry documents only "the record that defined him is notated G major functioning as D Mixolydian", so C and A are inferred neighbours and are not in the research. ⛔ **The bass was authored `reese_sustain` and the research does not say the bass is held.** It says *"sub-bass and round synth bass on roots, mixed loud so that bass-plus-vocal-stack is a complete arrangement"* — loud and round, not sustained — so the honest rhythm is the one that follows *"one deep kick"*, which is `mirror_kick`. On `reese_sustain` this model reached **334 distinct basslines in 1,000 seeds** against a floor of 500, because that rhythm emits one note per chord (TASK-162). The `b7` in `cellShapes` is the sourced half: the keys line is *"major-with-flat-7 and three-chord loops with the flat-7 as the colour chord"*. ⚠ **INFERRED:** `followRootsProb` 0.90 and `anticipationProb` 0.20 are lane-conventional rates, not sourced ones.
